label: node-identity
sql: SELECT count(*),count(DISTINCT concat('N',length(source_system),':',source_system,':',type_id,':',id)) FROM client_dev.ashlar_scale_20261005_i1.object_current VERSION AS OF 2

columns.name: count(DISTINCT concat(N, length(source_system), :, source_system, :, type_id, :, id))

label: edge-identity
sql: SELECT count(*),count(DISTINCT concat('E',length(source_system),':',source_system,':',rel_type_id,':',id)) FROM client_dev.ashlar_edge_ingest_20261005_l1.edge_current VERSION AS OF 2

columns.name: count(DISTINCT concat(E, length(source_system), :, source_system, :, rel_type_id, :, id))

label: typed-endpoints
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM client_dev.ashlar_edge_ingest_20261005_l1.edge_current VERSION AS OF 2 e LEFT JOIN client_dev.ashlar_scale_20261005_i1.object_current VERSION AS OF 2 s ON e.source_system=s.source_system AND e.source_type=s.type_id AND e.source_id=s.id LEFT JOIN client_dev.ashlar_scale_20261005_i1.object_current VERSION AS OF 2 t ON e.source_system=t.source_system AND e.target_type=t.type_id AND e.target_id=t.id WHERE s.id IS NULL OR t.id IS NULL

label: adjacency-parity
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM client_dev.ashlar_edge_ingest_20261005_l1.adjacency VERSION AS OF 0 a FULL OUTER JOIN client_dev.ashlar_edge_ingest_20261005_l1.edge_current VERSION AS OF 2 e ON a.source_system=e.source_system AND a.rel_type_id=e.rel_type_id AND a.id=e.id WHERE a.id IS NULL OR e.id IS NULL OR a.source_type<>e.source_type OR a.source_id<>e.source_id OR a.target_type<>e.target_type OR a.target_id<>e.target_id

label: parallel-pairs
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT source_system,rel_type_id,source_type,source_id,target_type,target_id,count(*) n FROM client_dev.ashlar_edge_ingest_20261005_l1.edge_current VERSION AS OF 2 GROUP BY ALL HAVING n=2)

label: isolates
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM client_dev.ashlar_scale_20261005_i1.object_current VERSION AS OF 2 n LEFT ANTI JOIN (SELECT source_system,source_type type_id,source_id id FROM client_dev.ashlar_edge_ingest_20261005_l1.edge_current VERSION AS OF 2 UNION SELECT source_system,target_type type_id,target_id id FROM client_dev.ashlar_edge_ingest_20261005_l1.edge_current VERSION AS OF 2) e ON n.source_system=e.source_system AND n.type_id=e.type_id AND n.id=e.id
